evidence: Changes fuzz testing files located entirely within `src/ipc/test/fuzz/` to test IPC interfaces and Cap'n Proto deserialization.
rationale: Expands the IPC fuzz target to test bidirectional callbacks, arbitrary Cap'n Proto payloads, and server-side deserialization. This provides useful coverage for process-boundary serialization as outlined in #23015 and requested in #35118, but does not fix an active bug or block core functionality.
